neighbours.label: A numeral morpheme inside a word or a counter after a numeral in non-English text (тр|ин|адцать, dre|ist|ufig, пол|мин|уты, 三项, 届): number-bound compounds

predictions: Russian, German and Chinese number compounds or counters reach 0.4-0.9; the same sentences with a non-numeral word stay under 0.1.
notes: Probe: тринадцать 0.920 (peak 'ин'), dreistufige 0.705, 三项 0.690, полминуты 0.496, тройку 0.426, 上届 0.390, unilocular 0.314; same Russian frame without a number 0.034. Splits checked: zweistufige = zwe|ist|ufig|e, полчаса = пол|час|а, четырнадцать and тридцать are multi-token, 三名 = 三|名, 五项 = 五|项.
